description: Official per-1M-token rates for every model seen in Multica runtime usage. Rates come ONLY from vendor pricing pages; each carries its source URL and capture date. cache_write is the default (5-minute) cache-write rate; cache_write_1h is kept for reference. Edit this file (or point AISTAT_PRICING_OVERRIDES at a second JSON with the same shape) to add or override models without code changes. A model that has no official public rate must be listed with "unpriced": true and a note — never priced at 0. An optional per-model "credits" block gives the OpenAI Codex rate-card credit rates (credits per 1M tokens: input / cache_read / output); when present, cost_credits is computed from it instead of the flat usd*AISTAT_CREDITS_PER_USD conversion. Claude models carry the mapped Codex-tier credit rates (Fable 5 = GPT-5.6 Sol; Opus 4.8 and Opus 5 = GPT-5.6 Terra) per owner directives FAN-1427 and FAN-1715; Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra have no mapped credit tier yet and use the flat conversion. OpenAI rates are Standard / short-context rates; usage has no service-tier or context-length discriminator for Fast or long-context pricing.
assumptions: Multica runtime usage reports four token counts per (runtime, model, day): input / output / cache_read / cache_write. input_tokens is the uncached remainder, so total cost = input*input + output*output + cache_read*cache_read + cache_write*cache_write, all per 1M tokens.

cache_write tokens are priced at the vendor's default 5-minute cache-write rate (Anthropic 1.25x input; OpenAI 1.25x uncached input, confirmed on the gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-6-astra model pages). Agents use the default ephemeral (5m) cache, so the 5m rate is the correct default; the 1h rate is recorded for reference/override.

cache_read tokens are priced at the vendor's published cache-hit rate for that model, never a universal ratio. Anthropic: 0.1x input for every model except Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, which are 0.025x input ($0.25/MTok on claude-fable-5-1) per the footnote on the official pricing table. OpenAI: the published cached-input rate (0.1x input for gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna and gpt-6-astra).

credits (OpenAI Codex rate card, https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001106-codex-rate-card, captured 2026-07-30) are per 1M tokens and cover input / cached input (cache_read) / output only; cache_write is not part of the credit card. Credit cost = (input*credits.input + cache_read*credits.cache_read + output*credits.output) / 1e6.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: Claude Opus 4.8. 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read (hit) = 0.1x input.

credits.notes: Credits billed as GPT-5.6 Terra per owner directive FAN-1427.

claude-opus-5.notes: Claude Opus 5. Uses the same 5m/1h cache and cache-read rates as Claude Opus 4.8 by owner directive FAN-1715; the model ID remains distinct.

credits.notes: Credits billed as GPT-5.6 Terra, matching Claude Opus 4.8, per owner directive FAN-1715.

claude-fable-5.notes: Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic's most capable widely released model). 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input.

credits.notes: Credits billed as GPT-5.6 Sol per owner directive FAN-1427.

claude-fable-5-1.notes: Claude Fable 5.1 (API ID claude-fable-5-1). effective_from is the release date 2026-09-01 from the official model overview (platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/overview); the rate was captured 2026-09-09. 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x. Cache read (hit) is 0.025x input ($0.25/MTok) on Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, not the 0.1x used by every other Claude model. No credits block: no owner directive maps Fable 5.1 to a Codex credit tier (FAN-1427 covers Fable 5 only), so cost_credits falls back to usd*AISTAT_CREDITS_PER_USD until one is recorded.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: Claude Sonnet 5. The $2/$10 launch price, originally introductory through 2026-08-31, is the standard price: Anthropic states the planned 2026-09-01 increase to $3/$15 will not occur (re-verified 2026-09-09). 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input. No credits block: no owner directive maps Sonnet to a Codex credit tier.

claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Claude Sonnet 4.6. 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input.

claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.notes: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (API ID claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929). 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input.

claude-sonnet-4-20250514.notes: Claude Sonnet 4 (API ID claude-sonnet-4-20250514; retired except on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud). 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.notes: Claude Haiku 4.5 (API ID claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input.

gpt-5.6-sol.notes: GPT-5.6 Sol Standard / short-context API rates before the 2026-08-21 promotional cut. Fast and long-context rates are excluded because usage has no service-tier or context-length discriminator.

credits.notes: Token-based Codex rate card; cache writes are excluded.

gpt-5.6-sol.notes: GPT-5.6 Sol promotional Standard / short-context API rates: OpenAI cut input $5->$4, cached input $0.50->$0.40, output $30->$20 on 2026-08-21 (API changelog) and states the promotional pricing is available at least through 2026-11-21; re-check this entry after that date. cache_write = 1.25x uncached input per the gpt-5.6-sol model page. Fast and long-context rates are excluded because usage has no service-tier or context-length discriminator.

credits.notes: Token-based Codex rate card; cache writes are excluded. OpenAI's 2026-08-21 announcement says the Sol cut also applies to Codex credits, but the rate card page could not be read on 2026-09-09, so these are the 2026-07-30 credit rates and may overstate credits until re-verified.

gpt-5.6-terra.notes: GPT-5.6 Terra Standard / short-context API rates. Fast and long-context rates are excluded because usage has no service-tier or context-length discriminator.

credits.notes: Token-based Codex rate card; cache writes are excluded.

credits.notes: Token-based Codex rate card; cache writes are excluded.

gpt-6-astra.notes: GPT-6 Astra Standard / short-context API rates. effective_from is the release date 2026-09-03 from the OpenAI API changelog; the rate was captured 2026-09-09. cache_read is the published cached-input rate (0.1x input); cache_write = 1.25x uncached input per the gpt-6-astra model page. Fast and long-context rates are excluded because usage has no service-tier or context-length discriminator. No credits block: the Codex rate card could not be re-read on 2026-09-09 and no owner directive maps GPT-6 Astra to a credit rate, so cost_credits falls back to usd*AISTAT_CREDITS_PER_USD.
